evidence.scope_summary: The ECB permits reuse of information obtained directly from it subject to accurate reproduction, source attribution, free-source notice for sold content and disclosure of modifications.
Rates are for information purposes only. Transactional use is strongly discouraged.

The Bank permits freely using, copying, distributing and transmitting website content with attribution, indication of changes, accuracy and a free-source notice for paid content. Exceptions cover banknotes, logos and third-party/licensed content.

Bank-published averages are indicative and not transaction-based; the Bank computes truncated means of aggregated financial-institution quotes. Underlying LSEG quotes are not acquired or redistributed.

review_scope: Public central-bank reference observations only; not third-party tick data, logos or commercial endorsement.
